entities.name: Javier Ibáñez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Javier Ibáñez Diaz is a Cuban-born Bulgarian boxer. He competed at the 2024 Summer Olympics, winning the bronze medal in the men's featherweight event. He competed as a bantamweight as a youth, and currently competes as a featherweight.
